source.note: Devnet deployment; program keypairs and address registry in ~/.config/omnipair/dusk-devnet. Binary attested from chain (upgradeable loader programdata). Re-pinned 2026-09-10 so a PDA created before a state field was added grows in place instead of being rejected: YieldAccount gained harvest_authority (Option<Pubkey>, 33 bytes), which made every yield account created before that deploy unopenable and broke add-liquidity on the devnet market with InvalidArgument 234 vs 267. The IDL is unchanged by this deploy and keeps digest 54b731d26acbce000b6d6e3dd6dfcc4b9099a9c1b8af9c34504e7f2d71db0f13. The previous binary (9d8bdf0b152fa798...) is preserved at dusk-keepers/artifacts/dusk-devnet-9d8bdf0b.so for rollback. source.worktreeFingerprintSha256 covers programs/ and is reproduced by scripts/compute-worktree-fingerprint.mjs.
